description: Three-step chain. Step 1 rebuilds the private student loan amortization schedule from loan amount, rate, and term. Step 2 checks the lender's disclosure packet across the three 12 CFR 1026.46-48 stages, HEOA self-certification presence, and the 3-business-day rescission window. Step 1 payment amount, totals, and execution hash are cited for manual comparison against the disclosed estimated total cost and repayment schedule; the checker does not read the lender's figures. Federal math only; not legal advice.
name: private-student-loan-disclosure-check

steps.handoff: Rebuilds the level-payment amortization schedule from the loan terms; payment amount, totals, and execution hash are cited for manual comparison at step 2.

Checks the disclosure packet across the three 12 CFR 1026.46-48 stages, HEOA self-certification presence, and the 3-business-day rescission window; step-1 totals are compared manually against the disclosed figures.
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: Private Student Loan Disclosure Check
